body.message:
I have replied in full by email today — please refer to it.

For the record: your message today says the owner arrives "tonight" (6 September). Your email yesterday said his arrival was on 4 September. Your message of 4 September at 14:24 said "from Sunday onwards". These three accounts cannot all be correct.

I will not be checking out today. DET case no. GOV-320439-W0F0Q is open and my email of 5 September remains unanswered — the Ejari, the DET permit, the booking terms you refer to, and the owner's booking confirmation have all been requested and none has been provided.

I remain willing to pay for September at AED 12,500, as I have now stated three times in writing. 

No one is to enter the unit or interfere with my family's occupation without my prior written consent. Any contact from building management or security acting on your instructions will be reported to Dubai Police immediately and added to the DET file.

Catarina Loução
